problem: The canonical production browser proof clicked the loss lifecycle tab but the corresponding pricing panel remained not visible.
root_cause: Pricing lifecycle visibility depended on the HTML hidden property plus normal display cascade. Production proof exposed that the visible state was not browser-hard enough under the accumulated pricing CSS/runtime layers.
prevention: Active lifecycle panels must explicitly remove the hidden attribute and receive display:block!important through the rescue state layer.
Inactive lifecycle panels must explicitly carry hidden and display:none!important.
The selected lifecycle key must be reflected on the document root for observable readback.
Production closure requires the actual browser click to make the selected panel visible.

evidence.failed_assertion: loss stage panel after click is not visible
